statement: The three-node seed rebalance integration test fits the release gate honestly: node joins carry their own measured budget JOIN_READY_TIMEOUT_MS of 25000 ms while READY_TIMEOUT_MS stays 12000 for the seed bootstrap, seed-API init and nodes-ready waits it actually fits, because node3's join measures 12441 to 14748 ms in every observation on an idle host both before and after the barrier cure — a bound below the observed floor can never pass, so the constant was mis-set rather than masking a regression, and lane classification is not the lever (the file is already primary class integration mapped to resource class exclusive at jobs 1, running alone). Two genuine defects found while measuring are cured in the same change: the join-time priority-placement formation barrier slept the full production five-second discovery window on every join before reaching the same bypassed_insufficient_formation_cohort answer, now compressible through the barrier's existing config seam exactly as TEST_CONFIG already compresses election waits (production JOINING_DEFAULT budgets unchanged and pinned, and compression never releases an ENGAGED barrier); and the Raft commit scheduler raised a false 'no durable progress' when teardown closed the SQLite log under an already-queued commit slice, where a closed adapter is now teardown while an open log answering an empty slice still raises it. Measured: the file goes from 0 of 10 to 8 of 8 green in its lane, and npm run test:ci exits 0 across 2110 files. TEST_TIMEOUT_MS and the nine assertion messages are unchanged.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
The file is already the serial lane's sole work (primary class integration maps to resource class exclusive with jobs 1), so lane classification cannot cure it and was not moved.

READY_TIMEOUT_MS stays 12000 for the waits it fits; the two node-join waits carry JOIN_READY_TIMEOUT_MS 25000, justified by a measured floor of 12441 ms and a ceiling of 14748 ms observed in every run both before and after the barrier cure — a bound below the observed floor can never pass, so this corrects a mis-set constant rather than masking a regression.
TEST_TIMEOUT_MS 120000, the JOINING_DEFAULT production budgets (5000/500/120000) and the nine assertion messages are unchanged and pinned by control witnesses.
The formation-barrier discovery window is compressible only through its existing config seam, and a sufficient cohort still latches and waits for startup authority.
A closed Raft log adapter stops the commit loop as teardown; an OPEN log answering an empty slice must still raise no durable progress.
The acceptance bar is npm run test:ci exiting 0 and the file passing repeatedly in its lane, measured and reported verbatim, never asserted.
